sources.note: Main product page. Describes Moyae as 'the modern operating system for vision-care.' Lists key features: embedded eRx, IOP tracking, intravitreal injections, retina drawings, AI-assisted coding, customizable templates, patient reviews, IRIS registry integration. Notes AWS hosting, Techstars backing, advisory board from Bascom Palmer/Baylor/Harvard/Stanford.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certification number, criteria, and export format (newline-delimited JSON FHIR data). Notes per-user billing model, additional fees for eRx and direct messaging, and potential data migration costs. Confirms MFA and ID.me identity proofing.

Blog listing page. Four posts found: MIPS compliance (March 2025), intravitreal injections and EMR (June 2024), ASCRS conference attendance (May 2024), future of ophthalmology documentation with FHIR and AI (Feb 2024).
Product updates page. Content loads dynamically. Static HTML reveals feature categories: eRx, Reviews, API, and 'Eligibility (Coming Soon).' Actual update entries not available in static fetch.

Medical advisory board page. Six ophthalmologists from Bascom Palmer, Baylor, Harvard/Mass Eye and Ear, Stanford, UT Southwestern, Wake Forest. Specialties include cornea, retina, vitreoretinal, neuro-ophthalmology, cataract, refractive surgery.

Press release on AdvancedMD partnership. Reveals Moyae handles clinical workflows (objective data, findings, medication prescribing, care planning) while AdvancedMD handles billing, scheduling, patient engagement. Bi-directional integration syncs patient histories, encounter docs, and claims to AdvancedMD billing ledger.
AdvancedMD's version of the partnership announcement. Confirms integration for billing and practice management. Page content did not fully render details.
GeekWire article on Techstars Seattle 2023 cohort including Moyae. Page blocked (403) but search results confirmed Moyae was among 24 startups in the cohort.
LinkedIn company page. Confirmed via search results: Moyae described as modern EHR for ophthalmologists and optometrists handling RCM, billing, scheduling, and patient records.
ZoomInfo company profile referenced in search results. Confirms Sami Mirimiri as Co-Founder & CEO.
